confidence_notes: Numbeo's Rethymno prices, last updated 6 October 2026, give useful meal, coffee and beer anchors, though its sample is limited to 19 contributors in the past 18 months and is not season-specific. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from the supplied comparable-city prices; hostel prices are less certain. Cocktail and wine estimates use their likely price relationship to local draft beer rather than direct city data.
comparable_city_reasoning: Rethymno is a popular Cretan coastal destination, with lodging demand comparable to Chania and Rhodes but on a smaller scale. I estimate its year-typical hotel prices near the lower end of those cities' supplied ranges, above Athens for basic rooms. Hostel estimates are guided by the supplied Athens, Chania and Rhodes examples.
